bio: Locals and tourists alike love to meet up at this bustling place. This old building on the Prinsengracht boasts a charming waterfront terrace and a lovely bistro-style interior. The renowned wine list (there is a wine bar at basement level) and modern culinary creations complement each other perfectly. The chef has a no-nonsense approach to cooking – a few elements that are full of flavour plus sauces for a fine accompaniment. This is Amsterdam at its coolest!...
